chunks: And from him, from Al-Hasan, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Aslam Al-Makki, from Amr ibn Wa'il

that it was said to him, 'How many times did the Messenger of Allah perform Hajj?' He said, 'Ten. Did you not hear of the Farewell Pilgrimage? How can there be a farewell unless he had performed Hajj before it?'
ai.seo_question: How many times did Prophet Muhammad perform Hajj according to Shia hadith sources?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the total number of Hajjs performed by the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his progeny) as ten, a count widely accepted in Shia and Sunni scholarship. The reference to Hajjat al-Wada' (the Farewell Pilgrimage) serves not only as a chronological marker but also as a rhetorical confirmation that the Prophet had previously performed nine other pilgrimages, thereby validating the completeness of his ritual practice before his final departure from this world.
